subject: POC bootcamp: hands-on kickoff + traffic/load play coordination
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novahealth.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC bootcamp: proposed kickoff + hands-on lab

Hey Jordan,

Thanks for walking us through the Redwood demo yesterday — Alex and I are excited to move to a short POC bootcamp where we run prompt-review, routing policy experiments, and a couple of scaled load passes to validate latency and cost at our 99th percentile. We'd like a compact 2.5 day block (kickoff + two hands-on sessions).

Goal: confirm model selection, fallback/routing rules, and run a light load test (50RPS burst, 1k daily steady).

Availability next week (PST): Thu 11/26 afternoon (after 1pm), Fri 11/27 morning, or Mon 11/30 all day. Can you propose a cadence (kickoff + two hands-on) and which RedWood engineers we should expect?

Attachments: I attached our internal matrix of test cases and traffic mix.

Thanks,
Lydia Park
Head of AI Integrations
NovaHealth

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novahealth.ai>, Alex Soto <alex.soto@novahealth.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC bootcamp: proposed kickoff + hands-on lab

Lydia, Alex — great to hear, excited to run this with you.

Quick proposal to keep the bootcamp tight but effective:
- Day 1 (kickoff, 90m): objectives, model shortlist, prework review, and target success metrics.
- Day 2 (hands-on lab A, 3h): prompt engineering + routing policy workshop (model tiering, prefix caching, fallback mapping).
- Day 3 (hands-on lab B, 2h + load pass): run 2 staged load passes with our monitoring; we’ll validate 95/99p latency and per-token economics.

We can run Thu 11/26 kickoff at 2:30pm PST, hands-on Friday 11/27 9:30am–12:30pm, and a short Monday 11/30 10:00–12:00 for load and wrap. If that works I’ll loop in infra and model ops (Marissa) and CS for runbook ops.

Marissa — can you and Laura join the hands-on sessions? Laura, we may need a short pre-check on our staging capacity (GPU pool pinning and fallback tiers).

Lydia — once you confirm availability I’ll send a calendar block and an agenda PDF.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@novahealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC bootcamp: hands-on scheduling & infra check

Jordan / team — quick internal sync before I confirm.

Laura: can you validate we can allocate a dedicated staging pool for the 11/27 load pass? Key asks: 2 x A100-equivalent GPUs with pinned capacity for 45 minutes; autoscale off for deterministic metrics. Also confirm whether we need a quantized variant for the high-throughput path.

Sergio: please prepare a routing policy template — include rules for region-aware routing (us-west/ash), fallback to smaller model on overload, and a prefix-caching note for conversational warmup. Add a short checklist for the hands-on (prompt buckets, eval prompts, golden responses).

I’ll review NovaHealth’s test matrix and suggest tweaks (we should drop very low-frequency edge-case prompts from the first pass).

---

Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC bootcamp: confirmed schedule and prework (invite + agenda)

Lydia / Alex — thanks for confirming times. Final schedule below and I’ve attached the kickoff agenda and our suggested prework:

Final schedule (PST):
- Thu 11/26 14:30–16:00: Kickoff (Jordan, Lydia, Alex, Marissa) — goals, success metrics, prework review.
- Fri 11/27 09:30–12:30: Hands-on Lab A (Jordan, Marissa, Laura, Sergio) — prompt review, routing policy mechanics, model tiering.
- Mon 11/30 10:00–12:00: Hands-on Lab B + load pass (Marissa, Sergio) — two staged load passes, runbook rehearsal and wrap.

Action items before kickoff:
- NovaHealth: confirm list of 20 golden prompts and mark high-priority (Lydia) — due 11/25 EOD.
- Redwood: send staging pool reservation confirmation (Marissa) and the routing policy template (Sergio) — due 11/26 09:00.
- Both: populate the shared spreadsheet with expected traffic mix (attached matrix).

Attachments: redwood-kickoff-agenda.pdf, novahealth-poc-multiplex-matrix.xlsx

Calendar invites are sent — please accept. We’ll use the shared Drive link for prework and a short post-run evaluation doc.

See you all on Thursday.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0182
